title: CapabilityCatalog
description: Read-only Runtime catalog of eight system atomic actions, two perception actions and only application send_message_by_nickname. Discovery is not permission to dispatch. Images use PNG/JPEG; file MIME is declared metadata, not type proof. Runtime limits 20 MiB/image, 100 MiB/file, 200 MiB total. Clipboard data may be exposed; validate preview. Native media and real sends are unverified. Localization screenshot counts exclude attachment observations; hot cache is not zero screenshots. V1 grants are rejected without upgrade. Nickname execution needs an explicit single-use instruction-level parent grant with fixed parameters instruction:send_message_by_nickname:v2, independent of all call parameters; content-bound digest values cannot authorize execution and are rejected as grants without conversion or automatic regrant. The send-by-nickname-v2-sha256 digest is immutable request audit/delegation/revocation identity only. Execution needs usable authorization/audit storage and native prerequisites including Accessibility, Input Monitoring, Screen Recording and supported whole-window capture APIs. Local vision is required only when a missing or stale SQLite coordinate, including an exact-nickname contact candidate, requires localization; model availability does not unconditionally gate the composite, and discovery cannot promise request-specific hits. Contact reuse still needs a fresh ContactCapture, unique exact ordinary-contact AX identity, current popup ownership and original screenshot binding checked before dispatch. Every child rechecks the exact immutable current-request digest/lease and narrow app/route/action restrictions without per-child approval; search/open/draft/send are internal helpers without standalone public actions, grants, routes or discovery schemas. Atomic input and key grants are separate.
